about: Evan's review inbox (app.abbies.world/review). Every thread appends one item when something needs Evan's eyes, newest first by `at`. Fields: id (unique slug), at (ISO time), title, ask (one plain line: what Evan decides), thread (thread title), link (where he acts), before/after (images, his pick then our result, same camera) or image, glb (optional 3D viewer of the result), status (waiting | coming | done). See README.md.
